_comment: Hardware classes of the trajectory (POL/Porto) timing profiles; same schema
The trajectory timing jobs export JOBLIGHT_TIMING_HARDWARE_SPEC=<this file>.
'allocated' binds a CPU profile to the exact CPU model of the node Slurm selects
for one timing job; every entry of one plan runs on that node.

cpu_1core.slurm_hint: scheduler-selected base node; exact CPU model is fixed and recorded after allocation

cpu_postgres_2core.slurm_hint: scheduler-selected base node; exact CPU model is fixed and recorded after allocation

cpu_fullnode_exclusive.slurm_hint: scheduler-selected exclusive base node; exact CPU model is fixed and recorded after allocation
